mainEntity.name: How can I convert Hindi speech to text for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Gboard voice typing on Android, the iPhone keyboard microphone, or Google Docs voice typing in Chrome with हिन्दी selected. All three are free.

mainEntity.name: Which is the best app for Hindi speech to text?

acceptedAnswer.text: For messages, Gboard on Android or the iPhone keyboard. For documents, Google Docs voice typing. For Hindi or Hinglish meetings, Lynkk records and summarises automatically.

mainEntity.name: Can I do Hindi voice typing on a laptop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Open Google Docs in Chrome, Edge or Safari, go to Tools, then Voice typing, and select हिन्दी. It works on Windows, Mac and Chromebook laptops.

mainEntity.name: Does Hindi speech to text work offline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some phone keyboards support offline voice typing after you download the language pack. Google Docs voice typing needs an internet connection.

mainEntity.name: Can speech to text write Hindi in English letters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Use a Hinglish or Hindi (Latin) keyboard layout on your phone, and dictation will write Hindi words in Roman script.

mainEntity.name: How do I convert a Hindi meeting recording to text?
